issues.description: The template Lecture class defines a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), but the problem statement and the solution expect a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in the specified order. This discrepancy can confuse students about the required constructor signature and will cause tests that expect the five-parameter constructor to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture constructor signature to match the specification and solution: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and either leave the body empty with TODOs or initialize the fields as in the solution. This ensures students implement against the correct constructor signature and avoids test failures.
